summary.text: Jennifer Kiggans is the incumbent Republican U.S. Representative for Virginia's 2nd District, a Navy veteran and nurse practitioner who served in the Virginia Senate before winning the House seat in 2022. According to her official biography, she sits on the Armed Services, Veterans' Affairs, and Natural Resources Committees. Her campaign website describes her priorities as lowering the cost of living, growing jobs, and government oversight.

paragraphs.text: Kiggans was born in Tampa, Florida, in 1971 and graduated from high school in Orlando.

She earned a bachelor's degree in international relations from Boston University (1993), a bachelor's degree in nursing from Old Dominion University (2011), and a master's degree in nursing from Vanderbilt University (2012). After college she taught English in Japan through the JET Programme in 1993-1994.
She served 10 years in the U.S. Navy as a helicopter pilot, flying H-46 and H-3 aircraft and completing two deployments to the Persian Gulf, before leaving active duty in 2003.

She later used her GI Bill benefits to train as a board-certified adult-geriatric primary care nurse practitioner, providing care to seniors in long-term care facilities and private practice in Virginia Beach and Norfolk.

Kiggans won the 2019 Republican primary for Virginia's 7th Senate District over Virginia Beach School Board member Carolyn Weems, 52% to 48%, and the November 2019 general election over Democrat Cheryl Turpin; she served in the Virginia Senate beginning in 2020.
In 2022 she won the Republican primary for Virginia's 2nd District and defeated Democratic incumbent Elaine Luria in the general election. She took office in January 2023 and was re-elected in 2024.
According to her official biography, the district includes Virginia Beach and the Eastern Shore, and she serves on the House Armed Services, Veterans' Affairs, and Natural Resources Committees.
She and her husband, a former F/A-18 pilot, live in Virginia Beach and have four grown children, according to the same biography.
